description: The dataset records sediment‑depth and radioisotope measurements from a single sampling event (LSMo22-1) taken at latitude 21.365278 N, longitude ‑104.568333 W, elevation 750 m on 2022‑04‑08. It contains 20 rows, with depth values ranging from 0 to 0.275 m and 210Pb concentrations from 0 to 147.1 units, including standard deviations and supported/unsupported fractions. 137Cs activity and its uncertainty are also provided. All columns represent geological and geochemical measurements, while latitude, longitude, and elevation give geographic context and the date column provides a temporal stamp. This sediment‑radioisotope data can be used to estimate recent sediment accumulation rates, date depositional layers, and analyze spatial patterns of radioisotope distribution in lake or reservoir sediments.
